label: NICENE_CONSTANTINOPOLITAN_CREED_1: The twelve positive article contents selected from the pinned…
definition: The twelve positive article contents selected from the pinned Greek transcription, in the existing CreedArticleList order. The twelvefold division is a repository modeling choice following the clauses, not conciliar numbering. The Spirit article retains the Greek Father-procession clause; neither a Latin addition nor an extra exclusivity condition is inserted.
note: This fixes content scope, not article truth or a claim of textual identity with later recitations.
